req.title: Player payload includes position
req.statement: The system shall include the position field on every player response.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-034 requires that every player response from GET /players/{id} includes the 'position' field. Tests cover: (1) EP positive — a known player UUID returns HTTP 200 with a non-empty 'position' field matching the fixture value; (2) NEG negative — an invalid/non-existent UUID returns HTTP 404, confirming the error pathway; (3) BVA boundary — the first player (squad 1, lowest boundary) and last player (squad 26, highest boundary) both return 'position'; (4) DT decision-table — verifies the exact 'position' string value matches the fixture, catching constant/string mutations; (5) EP additional — verifies 'position' key is present in JSON body and is a non-empty string, catching field-omission mutations.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_includes_position_field
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows
Player with id '5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0' (Franco Armani, squad 1) exists
trace: R-PLAYER-034: position field must be present on every player response
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_player_by_id_includes_position_field():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert 'position' in body
    assert body['position'] == 'Goalkeeper'
    assert isinstance(body['position'], str)
    assert len(body['position']) > 0

test_get_player_by_id_includes_position_field()

tests.name: test_get_player_position_is_string_and_nonempty_for_multiple_players
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows
Players with various positions exist (Goalkeeper, Centre-Back, Centre-Forward)
actions: Send GET for three distinct player UUIDs covering different positions
Assert each response has a non-empty string 'position'
expected: All three responses include 'position' as a non-empty string
Each 'position' matches the fixture value exactly
trace: R-PLAYER-034: position field must be present on EVERY player response
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_player_position_is_string_and_nonempty_for_multiple_players():
    client = TestClient(app)
    cases = [
        ('01772c59-43f0-5d85-b913-c78e4e281452', 'Goalkeeper', 23),
        ('d5f7dd7a-1dcb-5960-ba27-e34865b63358', 'Centre-Back', 19),
        ('38bae91d-8519-55a2-b30a-b9fe38849bfb', 'Centre-Forward', 9),
    ]
    for player_id, expected_position, expected_squad in cases:
        r = client.get(f'/players/{player_id}')
        assert r.status_code == 200
        body = r.json()
        assert 'position' in body
        assert body['position'] == expected_position
        assert isinstance(body['position'], str)
        assert len(body['position']) > 0
        assert body['squadNumber'] == expected_squad

test_get_player_position_is_string_and_nonempty_for_multiple_players()
